summary: This 8-K filing by First Guaranty Bancshares, Inc. under Item 8.01 Other Events discloses a routine quarterly cash dividend declaration. On May 21, 2026, the Board declared a $0.01 per share dividend on common stock, payable June 30, 2026 to holders of record June 26, 2026. It marks the 132nd consecutive quarterly dividend. No special-situation event, transaction, or strategic initiative is present. The filing is a standard communication of ordinary dividend policy and does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, activism, restructuring, or any non-routine corporate action.
